name: Sei Shoujo Kishi
source:
In this game, you train female warrior Leon from outer world - in order to conquer Welzer empire, who is trying to evade Japan.
You can acquire skill by using the points you can get from training, as well as improving ability.
Avoid Welzer empire's attack and achieve Leon's purpose!

[From DLsite English]
translation:
在本作中，你将培育来自异世界的女战士莉音，击败企图侵略日本的威尔泽帝国。
你可以通过训练获取点数，以此习得技能并提升各项能力。
化解威尔泽帝国的攻势，协助莉音达成使命吧！

[摘自DLsite英文版]
